parsed.rationale: ShowContainerProtocol and TrackContainerProtocol in package Playback are structurally identical across four of their five members (isStale:Bool, lastRefreshedAt:Date?, pageToken:String?, and the shared-field-count of 4), differing only in the single slot 'item:Show' vs 'item:Track'. This is a textbook PAT opportunity: introducing an associatedtype Item collapses both protocols into one generic ContainerProtocol<Item>, eliminating the duplication while preserving full type safety for Show and Track consumers. Both files live in the same package (Playback) and neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code, so there is no intentional-duplication rationale to block the refactor.
